written.myAnswer: Using computers safely and responsibly helps protect personal information and avoid harm, while encouraging appropriate choices about hardware and software.
Choosing hardware and software suited to your needs can improve safety and efficiency and ensure that programs work properly with the computer.
Antivirus software helps detect and prevent viruses and other threats that could damage a computer or compromise information.
Choose hardware and software that fit your tasks, use secure and updated software, and check software requirements against the computer’s specifications.
Compatible hardware and software work properly together, helping programs run as intended and making computer use more effective and less frustrating.

Responsible computer use helps protect information and encourages respectful, ethical behavior. Choosing suitable hardware and software improves safety and efficiency, and checking system requirements against the computer’s specifications helps ensure compatibility.
